title: Clip files follow the clip's warp settings and stay in step when clips change
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Clip files follow the clip's warp settings and stay in step with the sample

  Scenario: One-shots on a drum stem use Beats, the rest Complex
    Given an analyzed drum stem with saved clips "shot-1" and "loop-1"
    And an analyzed horn stem with a saved clip "loop-1"
    When I export their sidecars
    Then the drum clips' warp mode is "beats"
    And the horn clip's warp mode is "complex"

  Scenario: A clip that was deleted loses its file
    Given clip files were exported for "steady-120.wav"
    And the saved clip "riff" was then deleted
    When I export its sidecars again
    Then "A-1bar-Bb riff.alc" is removed
    And the output says "removed A-1bar-Bb riff.alc (clip no longer saved)"

  Scenario: A clip file edited in the DAW is kept
    Given the clip file "A-1bar-Bb loop-1.alc" was edited in the DAW
    When I export its sidecars again
    Then that file is unchanged
    And the output says it was edited in the DAW and names --force

  Scenario: A renamed clip replaces its old file
    Given clip files were exported and "riff" was renamed "hook"
    When I export its sidecars again
    Then "A-1bar-Bb hook.alc" exists and "A-1bar-Bb riff.alc" does not
```
